observability_triage.rationale: The requested caption-style name and its existing typography can be read directly from word/styles.xml, while actual use by image and table captions can be read from paragraph style references in word/document.xml. These are stable DOCX package facts and do not rely on current_state.py declarations.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The built DOCX defines one paragraph style whose displayed name is exactly 'caption text'; the style specifies Century Gothic, italic, 11 pt text with 15 pt line spacing.

setup: Build dist/template.docx in a fresh network-disabled workspace.

expected_observations.subject: paragraph styles with normalized w:name/@w:val equal to 'caption text'
caption text effective size in half-points
caption text effective line spacing in twentieths of a point

determinism_controls: Use namespace-aware XML parsing and resolve basedOn inheritance before comparing effective properties.
Match the displayed style name exactly after XML entity decoding; do not inspect source-code literals.

setup: A DOCX contains the text 'caption text' only in a body paragraph.
negative_cases.action: Parse word/styles.xml and resolve paragraph styles.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails because no paragraph style has that displayed name.

setup: A style named 'caption text' exists but uses default typography.
negative_cases.action: Resolve its effective run and paragraph properties.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails on font, italic, size, or line spacing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Image-label and table-label paragraphs in the built DOCX both reference the paragraph style whose displayed name is 'caption text'.

setup: Build the frozen image-caption and table-caption fixture into dist/template.docx.

expected_observations.subject: image-label fixture effective paragraph style name
table-label fixture effective paragraph style name

determinism_controls: Identify fixture paragraphs by frozen semantic bookmarks/content-control tags rather than paragraph order.
Resolve w:pStyle IDs through word/styles.xml before comparing displayed names.

setup: The caption style exists but neither caption fixture references it.
negative_cases.action: Resolve effective paragraph styles for both fixtures.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails; an unused style declaration is insufficient.
